name: The Ugly First Draft
why_it_works: People love seeing that good work started bad. Showing the embarrassing first version lowers the creator off the pedestal, makes the final feel earned, and invites comments about which version people prefer.

hook.pattern: Show the worst early version first and call it out bluntly.
examples: This is version one of our {{product}}. It's bad. Watch.
Nobody was supposed to see this {{product}} draft.
Draft one vs draft {{draft_count}}. Be honest.

variables.name: product
variables.description: The thing that went through drafts

variables.name: first_problem
variables.description: What was wrong with version one
variables.example: the logo cracked after one wash

variables.name: offer
variables.example: the final version drops Friday at noon

beats.voiceover: This is version one. It's bad.

visual.prompt: Rough first prototype of a {{product}} on a cluttered work table, harsh overhead fluorescent light, visible flaws, phone-photo realism, vertical 9:16
Close-up of the flaw on the early {{product}}: {{first_problem}}, macro detail, flat light, vertical 9:16
Overhead time-lapse style shot of many {{product}} prototypes being laid out in a row on a studio floor, each slightly better, vertical 9:16
Hands holding the key material or tool behind {{turning_change}} next to a {{product}}, warm daylight from a window, vertical 9:16

beats.voiceover: Draft one, final. Which one would you buy?

visual.prompt: Side-by-side of the first {{product}} prototype and the polished final from {{brand}}, same table, clean even light, vertical 9:16

cta: Comment which draft you'd have kept, then catch the drop: {{offer}}.

slides.body: Swipe back and compare. Be honest.

craft.notes: Lead with the flaw, not the win. The audience has to feel slight cringe in the first frame so the final version reads as a payoff. Ask a binary question at the end to pull comments.

do_not: Stage a fake bad draft; viewers can tell when the flaw is manufactured
Skip the specific fix; vague 'we worked hard' kills the payoff
Show more than one flaw per beat
